'''Armor of the Pack''', also known as '''Pack Armor''', is an {{Epic}} [[Armor]] set unlocked at {{CollectionLink|Wolf Slayer|6}}.

== Obtaining ==

== Trivia ==
*The armor set has never been popular due to its impracticality in an actual combat situation. Even if you work ahead of time to assemble a class of players that all own the armor, the set bonus still isn't as useful as it seems. The bonuses it provides are even more redundant as the [[Mastiff Armor]], unlocked earlier at {{CollectionLink|Wolf Slayer|4}} is much more practical for taking on the slayer boss, especially when used in tandem with the [[Pooch Sword]].
**If the leggings are transferred to [[Rift Dimension]], its item lore will change to "{{Gray|Imagine an armor piece so bad that it need to travel to another dimension to become relevant}}". An obvious joke based on its unpopularity.
*The Helmet of the Pack is one of 6 armor pieces which have the hex color code of {{Color Display|#FFFFFF}}. The others are {{Item|Heavy Helmet}}, {{Item|Heavy Boots}}, {{Item|Kelly's T-Shirt}}, {{Item|Leggings of the Coven}} (white variant) and {{Item|Snow Suit Armor}}.
*The Chestplate of the Pack shares the Color {{Color Display|#FF0000}} with {{Item|Mushroom Armor}}.
